title: Alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='12' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='24' r='7' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='12' fill='#ffd94a'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='24' r='7' fill='#ffe98a'/>
  <!-- bell feet -->
  <rect x='21' y='33' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#d8a72a'/>
  <rect x='73' y='33' width='6' height='10' rx='3' fill='#d8a72a'/>
  <!-- hammers -->
  <rect x='46' y='12' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#ff7a45'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='11' r='5' fill='#ff9a6b'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='34' fill='#3d8bfd'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#7fb4ff' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='25' fill='#fdf6e3'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='25' fill='none' stroke='#c9b98f' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- ticks -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='37' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#6b6250'/>
  <rect x='48.5' y='78' width='3' height='5' rx='1.5' fill='#6b6250'/>
  <rect x='27' y='58.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6b6250'/>
  <rect x='68' y='58.5' width='5' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#6b6250'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='46' width='3' height='15' rx='1.5' fill='#2a3a5c'/>
  <rect x='50' y='58.5' width='13' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2a3a5c'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='60' r='3' fill='#e8503a'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='88' width='10' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2c6fd0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='88' width='10' height='9' rx='3' fill='#2c6fd0'/>
</svg>
